caption: This drawing features an iron trivet with a heart-shaped base formed by a wide, flat metal band. The base contains two straight crossbars and a central, curved scroll design. Three short vertical legs extend down from the base, supporting it. A flat, elongated handle, attached to one end of the heart shape, extends outward and has a small hole at its rounded tip. The trivet is illustrated in gray tones, indicating metallic material. In the upper left corner, the drawing also includes a technical overhead view, a side elevation, and a small scale bar, all depicted in black and gray linework. The main, more detailed perspective drawing is shaded, giving a three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain off-white, and there is a signature reading "J. LIPKIN" in the lower right corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
